title: Sector Intelligence pilot evaluation (intelligence-eval-v1)
description: One per-lake normalized evaluation as written to /lakes/{k}/states/intelligence for an EVALUATED pilot lake (evaluation.EVAL_VERSION). It restates specialist Brain states with provenance; it carries no rating, score or recommendation and no customer consumes it. The top level is closed: a new field is a new contract version. Lakes that are not evaluated carry input availability only (docs/brains/SECTOR_INTELLIGENCE_BRAIN_INTEGRATION.md). Validated against real evaluation output by tests/test_evaluation_contract.py.

inputsUsed.description: slot -> the input actually used (absent when none was usable)

inputs.description: slot -> {brainId, slot, status PUBLISHED|STALE|DEGRADED|NOT_PUBLISHED, ...}; every dependency appears

drivers.description: restatements of specialist values, each naming its slot; never a rating
